examples.code:
# Create a Blur node and set a 10 pixel blur.
blur = nuke.createNode("Blur")
blur["size"].setValue(10)
blur["filter"].setValue("gaussian")
examples.title: Create a Gaussian blur

examples.code:
# Create a Blur and limit the effect to RGB.
blur = nuke.createNode("Blur")
blur["channels"].setValue("rgb")
blur["size"].setValue(20)
examples.title: Blur only RGB

examples.code:
# Set horizontal and vertical blur independently.
blur = nuke.createNode("Blur")
blur["size"].setValue(25, 0)
blur["size"].setValue(5, 1)
examples.title: Use different horizontal and vertical values
